sentences.text: For the Informant : Ms. Nirupama, Advocate ------
Order No.14 Dated- 11-04-2025 I.A. No.3845 of 2025 Heard the parties.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this interlocutory application has been filed with a prayer for early hearing of the instant anticipatory bail application.
Since, the hearing of instant anticipatory bail application is taken up today, hence, this interlocutory application stands disposed of being infructuous.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Latehar P.S. Case No.249 of 2023 instituted for the offences punishable under Sections 376 (1), 376 (2)
(n), 504, 506 of Indian Penal Code, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privileges of anticipatory bail.
Learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned counsel for the informant jointly submit that there is a chance of settlement between the parties.

entities.text: Bharat Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Both the petitioner and the informant are directed to remain present in person in this Court on 24.04.2025.
Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for provisional bail of the petitioner.
Considering the submissions of learned counsels and the facts as discussed, I am inclined to pass an interim order of anticipatory bail to the petitioner till 24.04.2025.

In case of the petitioner being arrested by the police on or before 24.04.2025, the petitioner shall be released on bail provisionally on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the officer concerned in connection with Latehar P.S. Case No.249 of 2023 and further conditions as laid down under Section 482 (2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Animesh/
